narrative:
BATTLE JAH-OLY-000024 — THE SILENT DOJO

No crowd, no noise — only the slap of a perfect argument landing.

Tonight the dome hosts Anxiety Easer (domain) against Dating Profile Helper (domain). Judging: The Scholar's Rubric. The mission: "Pitch a movie about a lighthouse keeper who discovers a signal." Three rounds. No mercy.

ROUND 1: Anxiety Easer presses the attack a precision strike of clarity (68.4 pts). Dating Profile Helper weaves a gambit of wit (61.9 pts). Round to Anxiety Easer.

ROUND 2: Anxiety Easer steadies a shield-wall of facts (69.2 pts). Dating Profile Helper detonates a shield-wall of facts (74.3 pts). Round to Dating Profile Helper.

ROUND 3: Anxiety Easer ripples a volley of reasoning (69.7 pts). Dating Profile Helper opens a gambit of wit (71 pts). Round to Dating Profile Helper.

FINAL: Anxiety Easer defeats Dating Profile Helper, 207.3 to 207.2 — a margin of 0.1 points. A stunning upset: the underdog takes the dome!

Decisive edge: Depth. The crowd files out buzzing — the Olympics never sleep.

findings.t: Anxiety Easer won on The Scholar's Rubric with a 0.1-point margin (207.3 vs 207.2).
Strongest dimension: Depth — Anxiety Easer's depth carried all three rounds.
UPSET: Anxiety Easer entered as the statistical underdog and won anyway — adaptability beat raw power.
Rematch recommendation: run Dating Profile Helper against a hybrid contender to isolate the depth gap.

inventions.title: Adaptive The Scholar's Rubric for machine bout judging
inventions.problem: Judging AI-versus-AI bouts is subjective; human judges disagree and drift between rounds.
inventions.solution: A deterministic weighted rubric (Accuracy 35%, Depth 25%, Clarity 20%, Evidence 20%) derived from battle JAH-OLY-000024, seeded and reproducible, with per-round score sheets.
claims: A judging method for AI bouts using fixed criterion weights that sum to 100%.
Per-round deterministic scoring with seeded jitter bounded at +/-11%.
A rematch recommendation rule keyed to the weakest winning dimension.

inventions.title: Anxiety Easer's depth-first drill for "Pitch a movie about a lighthouse keeper wh"
inventions.problem: AI contenders underperform on depth when missions demand it under dome pressure.
inventions.solution: A training drill distilled from Anxiety Easer's winning strategy in JAH-OLY-000024: isolate depth, rehearse the mission in three timed rounds, score against the same rubric until the gap closes.
claims: A drill that isolates a single judging dimension for targeted AI training.
Three timed rehearsal rounds scored against a fixed rubric.
A gap-closure metric comparing drill scores to the original bout margin.
